children: ) on Thursday announced that it has submitted a redemption notice to the trustee for redemption of all of its outstanding 1.707% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2027 issued in the principal amount of $500M.

The firm highlighted that the notes will be redeemed on November 1, 2026, pursuant to their terms and conditions, for an amount equal to 100% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest thereon to, but excluding, the redemption date. The redemption price will become due and payable on the redemption date.

title: Fifth Third Bancorp to redeem $500M senior notes due 2027
